note: For fixed k>=0 and j in [0,k], 2^(k-j) binom(k+j,j) counts length-(2k+1) binary words with k zeros and j ones before a forced zero at position k+j+1, followed by an arbitrary suffix of length k-j. This is exactly the class whose (k+1)-st zero is there. These classes partition words with a zero majority. Complement swaps zero-majority and one-majority words, which partition the odd-length word set; hence count is half of 2^(2k+1)=4^k. Boundary k=0 is automatic.
